page.notes: Printed hyphens are kept at line ends. The left-margin notes are set in smaller type; "Consequen-tiç." may be read with some doubt. The word "euenturæ" is printed with an unclear first letter and may be "cuenturæ". "si-ue" is read from a broken word at a line end. "hypostaticę" is partly unclear. The Matthew quotation is copied as printed, including "quàm" and "sistat", even where it differs from the Vulgate. The first line of the page is a continuation from the previous page.
